cards.text: The LORD has just finished giving Moses, Israel's leader, the laws for the offerings. Now He tells Moses to take Aaron, Moses' brother (Exodus 4:14), and Aaron's sons, plus their garments, the anointing oil, a bull for the sin offering, two rams and a basket of unleavened bread. Friend, that's not a to-do list. That's a MOVING TRUCK.

cards.question: Along with Aaron, his sons and all those supplies, Moses also has to gather people at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting. Who?
True or false: Moses asks the LORD for a few more days to get everyone ready.

cards.text: With everyone gathered, Moses says, "This is what the LORD has commanded to be done." Then he brings Aaron and his sons up in front of the WHOLE crowd, no pressure, Aaron.

cards.question: Before any fancy clothes go on, Moses washes Aaron and his sons with ___.

cards.text: Then comes the outfit, and it is a LOT of outfit: tunic, sash, robe, ephod, woven band, then the breastpiece with the Urim and Thummim placed inside. Friend, I wear ONE apron and I still tie it crooked.

cards.question: Last comes the turban on Aaron's head. What does Moses set on the front of it?

answers.text: A gold plate called the holy diadem
Two onyx stones set in gold
A crown made of olive branches

cards.text: Next, Moses takes the anointing oil and anoints the tabernacle and everything in it to consecrate it. Then he heads for the altar, oil still in hand.

cards.question: Moses sprinkles some of the anointing oil on the altar ___ times.
Aaron is standing there in the full outfit while the oil goes on the tabernacle and the altar. True or false: Moses pours some of the anointing oil on Aaron's head too.

cards.text: Then Moses brings Aaron's sons forward and dresses them too, just as the LORD commanded him.

cards.question: True or false: Aaron's sons get the exact same outfit as Aaron, ephod and breastpiece included.

cards.text: Now the offerings begin. Moses brings the bull near for the sin offering.

cards.question: Aaron and his sons lay their ___ on the head of the bull for the sin offering.

cards.text: Moses slaughters the bull and, with his finger, puts some of its blood on all four horns of the altar. The rest he pours out at the base of the altar.

cards.question: Why does Moses put the bull's blood on the altar?

answers.text: To purify it so atonement can be made on it
To mark it as belonging to Aaron alone
To warn the people not to come near it

cards.text: Then Moses burns the fat on the entrails, the lobe of the liver and both kidneys with their fat on the altar. But that's not the whole bull, friend.

cards.question: What does Moses do with the rest of the sin offering bull, its hide and flesh and dung?

answers.text: Gives it to the people to eat

cards.text: Then comes the ram for the burnt offering, and Aaron and his sons lay their hands on its head. Moses slaughters it, splatters the blood on all sides of the altar, cuts it into pieces and burns the head, the pieces and the fat.

cards.question: The head, the pieces and the fat of the burnt offering ram are burning. What does Moses do with its entrails and legs?

answers.text: Washes them and burns them too
Gives them to the priests to eat

cards.text: After that comes the other ram, the ram of ordination. Aaron and his sons lay their hands on its head, and Moses slaughters it.

cards.question: Moses takes some of the ordination ram's blood and puts it on Aaron. Where does it go?

answers.text: His right earlobe and right thumb and right big toe
His forehead and both hands and both feet
His chest and both shoulders and his back

cards.question: True or false: Only Aaron gets the ordination ram's blood on him, and his sons skip this part.

cards.text: Moses puts the blood on the same spots on each of the sons, then splatters it on all sides of the altar. Friend, I have stamped a LOT of things in my life, and never once a big toe.
Next, Moses takes the fat and the right thigh. From the basket of unleavened bread before the LORD, he sets one cake of unleavened bread, one cake made with oil and one wafer right on top.

cards.question: Moses puts the fat, the thigh and the bread into the hands of Aaron and his sons. What happens to it all next?

answers.text: It's set on the golden table

cards.question: True or false: After the wave offering, Aaron and his sons get to keep the fat, the thigh and the bread.

cards.text: Moses takes it all back and burns it on the altar as an ordination offering, a pleasing aroma to the LORD. Then he waves the breast before the LORD, and that piece is Moses' portion of the ram of ordination.

cards.question: Next, Moses takes some anointing oil and some blood from the altar. He sprinkles them on Aaron and his sons and on their ___.

cards.text: Then Moses tells Aaron and his sons to boil the meat at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and eat it right there with the bread from the basket of ordination offerings. FINALLY, friend, after all that, somebody gets to eat.

cards.question: True or false: Moses lets Aaron and his sons save whatever meat and bread is left over for later.

cards.text: Then Moses gives them a stay-put order. They must not go outside the entrance to the Tent of Meeting until the days of their ordination are complete.

cards.question: Moses says it will take ___ days to ordain Aaron and his sons.
Moses says everything done today was commanded by the LORD to make ___ on behalf of Aaron and his sons.

cards.text: Moses tells them to stay at the entrance day and night for seven days and keep the LORD's charge, so that they will not die. Day AND night, friend, no snooze button, no quick run out, no "be right back."

cards.question: Seven days at the entrance, with orders from the LORD through Moses. How do Aaron and his sons respond?

answers.text: They do everything the LORD commanded
They ask Moses to shorten the days
They step out after the first night

cards.text: And that's where we'll pause, friend, right there at the door of the Tent. Trust me, this story is NOT over.
